questions.title: 01 Read derivative notation
questions.objective: Identify the limit that defines the derivative at the stated point.
questions.prerequisites: Read function evaluation, a nonzero increment and a limit.

questions.title: 02 Complete a derivative calculation
questions.objective: Evaluate the limit of the simplified difference quotient.
questions.prerequisites: Understand that h approaches zero through nonzero values.

questions.title: 03 Choose the factorization
questions.objective: Factor the numerator so the common nonzero increment can cancel.
questions.prerequisites: Expand a square and factor a polynomial.

questions.title: 04 Explain the cancellation condition
questions.objective: State when cancelling the common increment is valid.
questions.prerequisites: Division by zero is undefined; a limit may use nearby nonzero inputs.

questions.title: 05 Repair the first expansion error
questions.objective: Find the first incorrect expansion line and correct the derivative.
questions.prerequisites: Expand a binomial square and collect like powers of h.

questions.title: 06 Find a fresh derivative value
questions.objective: Choose the derivative of the given function at the stated point.
questions.prerequisites: Distinguish a function value from a derivative value.
